properties.name: A report says what it swept and whether its checks were exercised, so a zero cannot be mistaken for a pass — and a zero-degree node is never reported as clean
properties.statement:
A report that contributes no findings must say whether it was EXERCISED AND FOUND NOTHING or HAD NOTHING TO EXAMINE, and must describe the scope it actually covered rather than a narrower one it was never given.

DISTINCT FROM THE FACT THE GUARD NAMED: `fact:defect-propose-heal-describes-neither-what-it-swept-nor-what-it-considered` is the OBSERVATION — what was measured, on which day, by whom. This is the INTENT — what must be true. A TemporalFact cannot be scheduled; a Requirement can.

THE THEME IS ALREADY ACCEPTED DOCTRINE rather than a new idea: `chg:a-null-and-a-vacuous-zero-now-say-which-they-are` gave scoped `detect_gaps` exactly this treatment, and dev_storyflow's dragon Boss independently named it a WIN — "flags its own vacuous zeros". This generalises what that change did in one place.

⚠️ THE STAKE IS NOT TIDINESS: a fleet runs `propose_heal` as the read-only evidence step of a standing stop on `apply_heal`, which DELETES NODES. A vacuous zero there is one skim away from lifting a gate on an irreversible operation.

── PARTLY DELIVERED 2026-08-16 (#210) ──
`propose_heal` now carries `scope`, `projects_in_scope` and `merge_candidates_considered`, and no longer names a Project the caller never chose. `merge_candidates_considered` is dev_storyflow's own idea (1) and their field name.

── STILL OWED, ADDED 2026-08-16 after the full fleet-log triage ──
Three further instances the #210 fix did not touch, each measured in real use, and the second is the worst thing in the whole log:

(a) ZERO-DEGREE NODES ARE NOT REPORTED. `detect_defects` answered `clean: true` with `structural_defects: 0` over a DesignEpoch carrying NO EDGES AT ALL — in two separate packages, through every health call of a session. A node with no edges is the most detectable structural defect there is, and it needs no judgement to identify, unlike the modularity cluster the tool did report. `heal.rs:879` does this for Decisions only. **Reflow2's own health check returned a false green on the pass whose job is structural soundness.**

(b) `disconnected_community` COMPUTES MODULARITY AND SPEAKS THE WORDS OF UNREACHABILITY — "disconnected from the rest of the design". The four nodes it named were all reachable by an undirected walk; the genuinely unreachable node was never mentioned. Either rename it to what it computes ("tightly-coupled cluster") or make it compute what it claims. A confident answer to a NEARBY question occupies the attention the right question needed.

(c) `open_questions` RETURNING 0 READS AS AN ALL-CLEAR while `loop_status` in the very next call reported 31 other owed items — and it is the orientation call a new session runs FIRST. Naming the other non-zero counts would be enough.

NOT IN SCOPE, unchanged: whether every reporting tool needs this treatment or only those whose zero is read as permission.

REPORTED BY dev_storyflow's fleet across 2026-08-08 to 2026-08-15, by three seats independently.
